def process(load2002, load2003, load2004, load2005, load2006, load2007, load2008, load2009, load2010, load2011, load2012, load2013, load2014, load2015, load2016, load2017, load2018, load2019, load2020, load2021, load2022, load2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    frames = [
        load2002, load2003, load2004, load2005, load2006, load2007, load2008, load2009,
        load2010, load2011, load2012, load2013, load2014, load2015, load2016, load2017,
        load2018, load2019, load2020, load2021, load2022, load2023,
    ]
    df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

    # Freshwater beaches only
    df = df[df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('fresh')].copy()

    # Violation indicates exceedance; normalize value variants (yes/YES/Yes)
    v = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['_isExceed'] = v.eq('yes')

    rates = (
        df.groupby('Year', as_index=False)
          .agg(totalSamples=('Violation', 'size'), exceedances=('_isExceed', 'sum'))
    )
    rates['exceedanceRate'] = rates['exceedances'] / rates['totalSamples']

    avg_rate = rates['exceedanceRate'].mean()
    rates['avgExceedanceRate'] = avg_rate

    # Compare rounded-to-2-decimal rates (as requested)
    rates['exceedanceRate_r2'] = rates['exceedanceRate'].round(2)
    rates['avgExceedanceRate_r2'] = round(float(avg_rate), 2)
    rates['aboveAvg_r2'] = rates['exceedanceRate_r2'] > rates['avgExceedanceRate_r2']

    return rates.sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)
